reviews.text: Camera snaps. I took a couple camera snaps and it brought up subscription so if you want to pay than this is fine but if you don’t than That’s bad

About three camera snaps. I took about three camera snaps and it brought up subscription. 😦 
I tried to take another but still the same thing. So if you want to pay than this is fine, but if you were hoping to take unlimited pictures and just avoid the subscription side, don’t bother. Unless you don’t mind getting three pictures and that’s it. 😕 
 I was thinking I’d be able to use this app more. 

Thank you though for this app to identify bugs and other things. 🙂

Seems beyond useless. Unless I am way behind the learning curve, it appears I can bring up or make a picture of, for example, an insect I would like to identify. First I have to tell the app it’s an insect I want to identify. Then, after much special effects, it pronounces that I have found an insect with 65% reliability. That’s it. Seriously?
Not impressed at all. I tried to identify several plants the. Most accuracy was 74%
Doesn’t get specific. Can’t get it to Id the exact name of the insect . What’s the point ? I know it is a bug.
Legit garbage. Took a picture of a houseplant to test it. Results are “leaf - 66% accuracy”

Horrible App: can’t detect even basic flowers or vegetables. Waste of money & time! Tried it out on spinach leaves, poppy flowers & herbs like basil and thyme- NOTHING!! Couldn’t even identify one of them- USELESS !

Cannot ID Anything. Testing this app to see what it can do. What a joke!!! Tried it on a simple Petunia. Could not ID!!! Tried on Red Rose. Could not ID!! Why can it be simple ?!? I do not recommend this app. If you want the wrong answer, then this app is for you.
Bad. It says I now have to pay to use it and it can’t identify anything

Horrible. This app is terrible I scanned my dog then it said it was a totally different breed than my dog is. than I scanned a small pumpkin then it said it was a squash and at the end it said it was a shoe like what!

Doesn't identify. If you are hoping to be able to identify a specific thing such as a plant , tree, insect, etc. this app is useless. Take a photo of a plant and it will give you the definition of a "plant", and tell you your photos match things like "plant", "leaf", and "science" at 85.2%. Waste of time.
My first time use and it correctly identified objects in the photo. Great work. Great work.

Dismal. I’m disappointed. There is a plant that I know the name of but I’ll be darned if I can remember. But this app told me I could not identify it. It’s a fairly common plant, usually planted outdoors in someone’s beds, not an indoor/house plant 
I’ll delete the app and try another one
Constant obvious mistakes. Charged me when it just said it would not. Not very useful
Didn’t identify spotted lantern fly. First two paid apps I tried identified the lantern fly. This app offered “beetle”.
Useless. I submitted a very clear photo of a firefly and it was identified as “insect.” This is an app better suited for toddlers who are learning to identify photos with words.
Smart identifier. This app is a piece of crap. It makes money for the inventor or distributor. And nothing more.Now I must fight to get my money back.
Worthless app. Total scam.. after third picture they want you to subscribe
This app is stupid.. I subscribed for one year and yet, it’s not working
Keep Looking. Very vague and extremely uncertain about what it’s actually identifying. Like a struggling student yelling out guesses like they are playing Pictionary.
Don’t bother. Useless.. Worst app ever! Don’t even bother, completely useless. So worthless.
Bad identification. When I was testing it I tested it on my bearded dragon. The results did not have bearded dragon.
Insect. Stuck on insect. Can’t change to plant or flowers. Guess it’s gonna be trash. Waste of time
Low level. Unhappy with the app, 10% only identifies flowers & plants!
Not smart or identifier. This app is terrible I took a picture of a tree and it told me it was grass. It says it’s only correct 30% of the time so far for me it’s been correct 0%.

Horrible. What a rip off 30 dollars a month 
You can keep it
Insect always is as insect no kidding. Taken picture over and over looking for a proper id only for it to say insect

Wrong 5 times in a row!. I just downloaded this to help ID a caterpillar. It told me it was 37% accurate an insect...🤦‍♀️
So, I tried my photo of a coral snake. 75% accurate it was a boa constrictor.
Tried a housefly. It told me 44% an oak leaf moth.
Tried an Iris, it told me it was a water lili. My photos were Not blurry or obscured in any way. 
This is terrible!
See things my way. So far it identifies things that are in the picture. Saves more room then doing individual identifiers
Ehhh. This is app is okay but like every other app you have to pay money for a premium subscription plan and then you get full access.
Not accurate. Tested it with two things, a basic elm tree and a frog. With the tree it could not identify. It said the frog was a lizard.

Wanted to like it but..... I have 2 apps I use for plant ID and when I saw this one that did insects too I thought it would be great. Except I took a picture of a spider and it said there was a 130% chance it's a widow spider (it's not) and 43% chance it's a spider. It IS 100% a spider!

Then I tried my butterfly bush, where I got a choice of flower, flowers in plant, or purple. 20-30%

I've reinstalled this 3 times and it's just a waste of time.
So much fun!. It is a family event to explore using this app in our wood! What an education!
Moth or roach. No way this looked like a house moth. I know a roach when I see one. You said 35% said it was a roach “Really!”
Insects. It hasn’t got one right ever since I started
Incredibly vague. Moth - you don’t say!? What kind of moth? It’s all links to Wikipedia.
Dumb. Took a picture of a spider and the app tells me it is a floor .
Cool concept, needs work. I always get “can not identify from this photo” or the suggested possibilities do not look like the plant I’m trying to figure out. 😢

Hope for better results.. No Id 
for my bug.
Bug id. Couldn’t identify bug

Smart leaf identifier. Sucked big-time it was did you meet with a leaf in a stem was not tell me what the plan was gave me no information just took pictures I took the pictures and it didn’t walk me through it all if I was doing something wrong it was it just sucked I can’t even give it one star

A flower is a flower. I could be doing something wrong but the picture of a flower I took identified as “flower”. Not helpful. I took a picture of a caterpillar to see what kind it was. “Caterpillar “ was the answer. Gee thanks.
This is a bruh moment. It was cool it identified my dog and my frog but then I went to identify a flower and it made me pay for a monthly payment (of course I didn’t pay) but BRUH
Insect is. Doesn’t tell anything except that it’s an insect. No help. Thanks

Negative stars. I take pictures and it said basil was an herb.. I know that, but I thought the point was to identify the species?! I used basil in my garden to get an idea of how well the app worked.. Not well at all. Will be deleting!

Ugh!. First try not even close to my pic 😡
Won’t let me send because it won’t take any nickname I put in 😡😡
😠. The picture was of hostas and it said basil sorry have to delete this app.
Awesome. I like how it’s not just flowers or plants

Not worth the download. I tried to identify an insect and the app twice gave results that had nothing to do with insects. After those 2 attempts the app wanted money. 
Don’t bother with this app.

I need the specific animal!. Well this app tells the right animal but i took a picture of my chihuahua and it said chihuahua but I wanted to know what it specifically was like the chihuahua breed so it’s not really good for the specific speed id say
Worthless. Worthless

Not impressed with the app at this point. I scanned a plant and it showed me a pair of pink pants? I’m a little bit confused with how this app actually works. I then scanned a flower and it did not identify it. It just said flower. App needs a lot of work or needs to be more user friendly.

Literally an awful app. I took a picture of a bug I wanted to identify against a plain white background and the app told me there was a 27% chance it was the sky… THE SKY. That was the closest match it could come up with “the celestial dome” that includes “everything that lies above the surface of the Earth”. Like are they kidding me or trying to be serious? 😒
Awful app. Would give it zero if I could. Just downloaded the app took a picture of an insect and it immediately tried to sell me a subscription without identifying the insect.

FAKE. This app is so fake and on top of it, once you use it at least 5 times it says you have to buy a pack for actual money!!! Just to make sure this app was fake I searched up a picture of cricket and it said it was a long horned beetle , which btw it looks nothing like it!!! DON’T BUY

Worthless.... I had a bug I wanted to identify. This app told me is it is 27% match for... "Insect." 
I thought maybe my picture was too poor or the bug was just that weird, so I snapped a photo of my dog... And the app informed me that he is a dog. Maybe. Not even 100%. 
What is even the point? The only way this would be useful is if you were from another planet and didn't know what literally anything was. "Is this a loving thing?" "Probably."

A crane fly is NOT a wolf spider. Three times with three different subjects (Arizona in March has what look like large mosquitos) and every time it identified the crane fly as a wolf spider. And then it said I had to pay for a subscription if I wanted to continue to try. Only after doing some research did I discover the crane fly identification. 

Fail.
Worthless. Not helpful at all
Pay 💵. It was correct but to take a picture I had to pay 💰
No ID. No matter the lighting or how clear the picture, this app doesn’t even come close to identifying common plants.
Nice app. Killet

Not accurate. DON’T BOTHER. Took a multiple photos of an insect at different angles. It can’t even detect that it’s an insect but identifies it as aluminum, shoe, mesh and other unrelated objects that doesn’t relate to the insect. Waste of my $2.99

Insect is insect. It correctly identified the pic was of an insect but failed to identify the type when took a pic, on the second pic. The others identified the pic as a leaf or water, the first made sense only in that the bug was on a leaf. This is likely only good on insects that don’t require any zoom or closeup.
Does not work at all. It wouldn’t even give me an answer! It just kept loading.
Not so good as bug identifier. Insect came up as wood. The bug was on a piece of metal..no wood to be found.
Poor accuracy. Could not even identify a dog
amazing. This app helps me in tree identification, plant identification and snap identifier. I use this for the purpose of education

Please.. I took a photo and it told me....drumroll please....CATERPILLAR. 
Duh.
wack. straight up useless

Didn’t ID anything correctly. I took photos of several plants (cacti, monstera, succulents and an umbrella plant). My “identifications” all came up as “leaf,” “soil,” and “houseplant.” Not even close to correct.
Waste of time. It doesn’t tell me what type of insect it is, just that it’s an insect.
Helpful. This helps me a lot when I tried to Identify creators.
poor. Took the first picture of the plant and all tells me it’s a potted plant I can see it’s a potted plant I don’t need to waste my money
Pathetic identifier. I think anyone can identify as thoroughly as app does!
Hobo spider. Was unable to identity a hobo spider.
Waste of time. I took a pic of an insect that I couldn’t identify and this app identified it as an insect👎🏻👎🏻
Don't bother. All this app tells you is whether it's a flower, herb or shrub. Really I can do that on my own.

Doesn’t work. I just recently bought this app and I tested it out. I tried many things but they would all be identified wrong, the only thing it got right was my dog which is a Labrador Retriever. I would not recommend this it was a waste of space.
Doesn’t work.... It doesn’t even work. I chose one and it was ropes.

Stupid App. I tried to look up a bug and it could only “identify” it as “beetle” or “insect wing.”

Horrible. Wish I wouldn’t have pre ordered and I want my money back, what a joke

Sorry. I am very sorry I got this app. It doesn’t really tell you anything. It comes up with an option to choose from then takes you to Wikipedia for general information that might not mean anything for what you’re looking for. 
I have chosen 1 star for this app because I couldn’t chose zero stars. Very disappointed.

Not ready for prime time. Identifies all plants as ‘leaf’. Couldn’t figure out what a maple leaf was. Plus, have to love the bots writing the 5 star ratings. I added a 1 star and almost immediately it added a 5 star to keep the ave rating at 3. I don’t normally write reviews but feel like I need to call out the fake 5 star ratings. The app is just not ready yet.
Horrible. Does not tell you the name of the plant. Wish I could get my money back!
Awesome, Amazing and so cool. This has to be one o the coolest apps. Amazing and accurate. What is that? Never wonder again. I love love love it

zil. Accuracy zill then the app didn’t work again

Amazing accuracy thus far !!. I’ve tested it indoors and it’s so smart, I took a photo of a Dolphin (photo mosaic puzzle) & it popped up with “Photomosaic”, and “Puzzle” Can’t outsmart this! Eventually it concluded it was a “Dolphin Photomosaic” by “Paul Lamond”. After a quick Google It was right!! I took a photo of a butterfly artwork & it popped up with “Art”. 

This really is smart Looking forward to getting outside & snapping a few mini beasts & wildlife.

This is Excellent !! Go get it...

What?. So far has failed at identifying 90% individual insects from perfect photos. Example crane fly is not an arachnid”live picture” A species in a group class IE beetles and butterflies it gives. Not individual insects, most have no data base?? Mind you the app, it’s new, so not without glitches, I suppose.

Don’t even.. I got this to identify a 3 cm long black ant, as I hadn’t previously come across such a large one indoors. It helpfully identified the ant as: an insect (with 45% probability of being right). I kind of worked that out myself, already, with 100% probability of being right. Delete.

Extremely expensive, not helpful. Seems to be an app designed to trap the unwary with exorbitant subscriptions more than anything else. Could not identify even simple specimens to anything beyond a common, generic name (eg ‘cockroach’) and gave confidence ratings of >100% (ie. impossible!). Although simplistic the IDs were at least more or less accurate (but not useful).
